intro.heading: Machine transport for active job sites and working properties
intro.content: Bellhouse provides float service when the real need is getting a machine moved safely and on time, not just finding a truck. That can mean shifting equipment between contractor jobs, delivering machines to a rural property, moving a dozer onto a site-prep job, or getting an excavator in place before the next phase starts.
keypoints: Bellhouse driver and securement handled for you
Excavators, skid steers, dozers, and similar site equipment
Useful for contractor schedules, farm properties, and moving machines between jobs

process.heading: How Bellhouse float service works
process.subheading: The key questions are what machine is moving, where it is going, and what the site needs when it arrives.

steps.title: Confirm the machine, pickup point, and destination
steps.description: Bellhouse reviews the equipment type, access, delivery timing, and whether the machine is moving between jobs, yards, or rural properties.

steps.title: Load and secure the equipment
steps.description: The machine is loaded and tied down with the right securement procedures for the move.

steps.title: Transport the machine to site
steps.description: Bellhouse moves the equipment to the next job, yard, or property in line with the planned timing.

steps.title: Unload and place it where it needs to work
steps.description: We unload the machine so the next phase can start instead of leaving the equipment move half-finished.

serviceArea.heading: Service Area
serviceArea.content: Bellhouse float service is available across linked service areas where machines need to move safely between jobs, yards, rural properties, and active construction sites.

items.question: What kinds of machines can Bellhouse move?
items.answer: Excavators, skid steers, dozers, tractors, and similar site equipment are common fits. If the machine has special transport requirements, Bellhouse can review the move before scheduling.

items.question: Is this a good fit for live contractor schedules and rural properties too?
items.answer: Yes. Bellhouse float service is used for contractor-led jobsite moves, rural and farm property deliveries, and machine shifts between active projects where timing matters.

items.question: Can Bellhouse unload the machine where it needs to work?
items.answer: Yes. Bellhouse unloads the equipment at the destination so the move supports the job instead of just dropping the machine somewhere nearby.

cta.heading: Need a machine moved on schedule?
cta.subheading: Send Bellhouse the machine type, pickup point, destination, and timing if you need float service tied to the job plan.
